name: Is AI Market Intelligence only useful for luxury properties?

mainEntity.name: Is AI Market Intelligence only useful for luxury properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, AI Market Intelligence is beneficial for all property types, not just luxury homes. While it can provide deep insights into high-value markets, its algorithms are equally effective at identifying trends and fair market values for residential, multi-family, or commercial properties across various price points. For buyers and sellers working with Kelby Contreras, this means gaining an advantage whether you are looking at a condo in Aventura or a single-family home in Pinecrest.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI Market Intelligence is useful for all property types, not just luxury, providing insights across various price points.
